digest: The ability to recover from consecutive failures is critical for adaptive behavior, yet the underlying neural mechanisms remain unclear.

In vivo screening of neuromodulatory inputs onto frontal-sensory cognitive control circuit identified a frontal cholinergic mechanism that counteracts lapses in attentional engagement following repeated errors.

93c5dde1cfe12787.title: Loss of the tumor suppressor p53 generates a signaling gradient that drives epithelial clonal expansion.
digest: Although tumor protein p53 (TP53) mutations are among the most common lesions in epithelial cancers, how p53 loss drives unrestrained clonal expansion remains unclear.
Working with mouse epidermis, we found that p53 suppresses clonal expansion by limiting progenitor self-renewal.

603f8c80a488e967.title: An integrated multi-omic atlas of the choroid plexus highlights conserved molecular programs of epithelial function
digest: The choroid plexus (ChP) is a specialized epithelial tissue responsible for production of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), maintenance of the blood-CSF barrier and regulation of CSF-borne signaling factors.

Co-expression network analysis resolved conserved epithelial meta-programs, and transcription factor regulatory inference identified OTX2, MSX1, and GLIS3 among conserved regulators of epithelial gene expression.

We found that cTBI induced persistent aberrant myelopoiesis in the CBM, characterized by expansion of inflammatory monocytes/macrophages (Mo/Macs), which aggravated with aging.

digest: A spatiotemporally controllable CRISPR-Cas system would be highly desirable for restricting gene editing to specific times and locations in vivo.
Ideally, such a system would be compatible with tissue- or cell-type-specific delivery by adeno-associated virus (AAV) and could be controlled from outside the body.
However, neither the delivery of controllable CRISPR-Cas systems by single AAV particles nor their noninvasive activation deep within tissue has yet been achieved.

26a6a7608813a3f7.title: X and Y chromosomes as determinants of aging and disease.
digest: Sex differences have traditionally been attributed to gonadal hormones, but accumulating evidence shows that sex chromosomes exert distinct, cell-autonomous effects on health, aging, and disease.
XX and XY complements alter gene dosage, epigenetic programming, immune signaling, metabolism, and cellular stress responses, which shape aging and disease trajectories in women and men.

a7633f51d525c616.title: Rapid Sepsis Diagnosis in Critically Ill Adults with Remoscope Label-Free Whole-Blood Imaging
digest: Sepsis is life-threatening, yet diagnosis remains a major global challenge because existing approaches lack speed and accuracy.

In a prospective study of 29 critically ill adults, multi-physician adjudication identified sepsis (n=13), non-infectious critical illness (n=12), and indeterminate status (n=4); these patients were compared to healthy controls (n=22).
Optimized for rule-out, the three-class model detected sepsis with 100% sensitivity and 85.3% specificity.

8df02cadf9a95cb5.title: Efficacy and safety of low-dose IL-2 in people with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes (DIABIL-2): a double-blind, multicentre, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 2b trial.
digest: Background Type 1 diabetes results from immune-mediated destruction of pancreatic β cells, driven partly by regulatory T-cell (Treg) insufficiency.
We previously showed that low-dose interleukin-2 (IL-2) selectively activates Tregs in people with type 1 diabetes.
Eligible participants were aged 6-35 years; had a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes; received insulin for less than 3 months; and had a peak C-peptide concentration of at least 0·2 pmol/mL.

digest: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cell therapy has transformed hematological cancer treatment, yet nearly half of patients still relapse or progress.

In a cohort of 129 patients across three German centers, shotgun metagenomics and targeted mass spectrometry revealed that reduced short-chain fatty acids, particularly valeric acid, prior to CAR-T cell therapy correlated with increased risk of disease progression.

1bbfa95cc5c8ec85.title: A health-system-scale, episode-resolved multimodal atlas of cancer cachexia
digest: Using longitudinal data from 52,236 patients with cancer, this study created a multimodal atlas of cancer cachexia, demonstrating that weight loss episodes are linked to systemic serologic signatures and specific tumor genotypes and can be predicted using integrated clinical and molecular data, enabling earlier identification.

46c7d87491312384.title: Peripheral CXCR3 blockade mitigates T cell infiltration and neurodegeneration in a mouse model of tauopathy.
digest: Chemokine receptor CXCR3 mediates T cell recruitment into inflamed tissues, but its role in tauopathies is unclear.
Here, we show that hippocampal injection of interferon-γ (IFNγ) acutely triggers CXCL10 upregulation and brain parenchymal T cell infiltration.
Genetic deletion or antibody-mediated blockade of CXCR3 prevented IFNγ-induced T cell infiltration.

Conclusions and relevance In this 7-year follow-up of the SWEDEGRAFT randomized clinical trial, no-touch saphenous vein harvesting was not shown to significantly reduce the composite of death from any cause, myocardial infarction, or repeat revascularization through 7 years of follow-up.

ac2db16a08c55389.title: Population-scale reconstruction of menopause dynamics reveals a physiological cliff at the final menstrual period
digest: By using a novel computational framework, a cross-sectional analysis on laboratory data from two independent cohorts reveals that the final menstrual period marks an abrupt, multisystem physiological shift, with sex hormone changes beginning more than 10 years before menopause onset.

Results A total of 373 patients were randomized to IntERact (n = 186) or EUC (n = 187).
Mean (SD) age was 25.0 (3.7) years, 195 patients (52.3%) were female, and 278 of 371 patients (74.9%) reported past 3-month RFBs at baseline.

Outcomes were assessed at 3, 6, 9, and 12 months.

digest: Here, we performed multiomic analyses on ascites samples from patients with cancer and identified RORC-expressing dendritic cells (RORC DCs) enriched in malignant ascites.

We devised a high-purity sorting strategy to enable in vitro experiments with patient-derived RORC DCs, which indicated that these cells were phenotypically stable and stimulated T cell proliferation while attenuating IFNG expression.

f4f87aea17e08200.title: Naive T cell decline limits cancer immunity in middle-aged male mice
digest: Using mice and supporting human data, we show that accelerated loss of naive CD8+ T cells in male mice leads to lymph node contraction and limited cancer antigen recognition. Restoring thymic output replenished naive CD8+ T cells and improved responses to immunotherapy in middle-aged male mice.
